template_data.lead_html: What I see inside every rushed SAM.gov registration.

rows.what_html: Wrong NAICS codes — invisible to the agencies most likely to award you work
Outdated point of contact — RFQs go unanswered, contracting officers move on
Expired registration — cannot receive any federal contract award, full stop

template_data.closer: THE RENEWAL IS NOT THE REVIEW.
